name: testpilot
description: TestPilot — turn manual QA workflows into reliable automated tests

scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.dev: pnpm build && concurrently -n demo,api,ui,open -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @testpilot/demo-webapp start" "pnpm --filter @testpilot/test-management dev" "pnpm --filter @testpilot/console dev" "node scripts/open-console.mjs"
scripts.smoke:demo: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @testpilot/test-management exec playwright install chromium && node scripts/demo-smoke.mjs
scripts.negative-probes: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @testpilot/test-management exec playwright install chromium && node scripts/negative-probes.mjs
scripts.start: pnpm build && concurrently -k -n demo,server -c blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @testpilot/demo-webapp start" "pnpm --filter @testpilot/test-management dev"
